card.name: Inside salicylate and overdose words
card.fires_on: The middle piece "icy" in split-up "salicylate" or "salicylic" in toxicity and overdose passages. It also fires on the start of "overdose" and, less often, on the middle of "hyponatremia".

modes.label: Salicylate split
modes.description: The "icy" piece in "sal-icy-late" or "sal-icy-lic" when toxicity or levels are discussed.
modes.example: Monitor for symptoms of sal<<icy>>late toxicity.

modes.label: Overdose spelling
modes.description: The start or middle of "overdosage" or "overdose", mostly for vitamin D.
modes.example: Common symptoms of vitamin D<< overd>>osage may include constipation

modes.label: Hyponatremia split
modes.description: A middle piece of "hyponatremia" after talk of drinking too much water.

card.writes: It leans toward words about excess or abnormal states, with some Chinese words meaning "moderate amount", "strange" or "mad".
card.plain: It fires partway through the word salicylate, and sometimes overdose, in passages about toxicity.
